detail.title: Path Dependence in Emergent Preference Formation: Synthesis of Longitudinal MARL Constraints
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the structural role of early communication constraints and multi-agent interaction protocols in shaping long-term agent preference stability, synthesizing existing literature without new external discovery slots.
